$Comment: Student: reach Friendly with the Mastery Trainer (the reputation Mmo_Mastery_Trainer), the first of
seven achievements in this folder that pay out as a player rises with the trainer.
REPUTATION_RANK credits every rank a player's standing has reached, each time it changes and when
they log in, so a player who jumps several ranks at once finds each rank's achievement waiting.
Target is the rank id and Qualifier the reputation id; the criterion's TextKey words the step with
the rank's name. Listing.Chains lists the seven together as one ladder, mastery_trainer_ranks, in
Each rank pays Essence of Life, 200 for each step up the ladder (200 here, 1400 at Grandmaster), and a
title. Standing comes from repeating lessons, so a rank pays no Mastery Point: points come only from
levelling and one-time content. The essence sits in Rewards.Claim and waits in the Mastery section of
the achievement book until the player collects it; the title (Titles/MMOSkillTree/) lands through
the Title reward kind in Rewards.Auto the moment the rank is reached, the one thing an achievement
pays without waiting to be collected.
To change what a rank pays, ship a file of the same name in a later pack and edit Rewards. Keep the
ids: a player's progress is filed under them.
